name: 26757 · Romney, WV
findings: ZIP 26757 (Romney) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 26757 (Romney) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 26757 (Romney) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
